messages:
suresh: Hey team — planning to pin galileo-3b-v2 to the model catalog and run a canary. Proposed window: Tue 2026-03-24 03:00 UTC (lowest traffic). Who can own deploy + smoke?
anya: I can own the deploy and watch infra metrics. Pinging @kevin for app-side smoke.
kevin: I can run end-to-end smoke + prompt set. Need PR link and canary percentages.
suresh: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/432 — includes model pin, quant profile, and staging config. Proposed canary plan: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 15m, then promote if stable.
maria: FYI ops — remember KV cache priming step in the runbook. I'll monitor routing and fallbacks.
maria: ```bash
# prime prefix cache
python tools/prime_cache.py --model galileo-3b-v2 --queries priming_prompts.json
```
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created: job 987654 — window 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z. Canary routing policy: weighted-traffic.
ops-oncall: I'll be on pager for the window. What is the rollback plan?
suresh: Rollback plan: immediate pin revert to galileo-3b-v1 + route all traffic to v1; infra quick-swap script in CI. Kevin/Maria please confirm rollback scripts and who runs them.
kevin: I have a tested rollback script in the PR artifacts: `scripts/rollback_pin.sh`. Will be available from CI.
anya: Smoke checklist (short): 1) 10-prompt smoke (latency p95 < 120ms), 2) quality spot-check (3 golden prompts; compare diffs), 3) error rate < 0.5%.
julie: I'll add a Console dashboard row for this route with token breakdown and an alert for 5xx spikes.
maria: Note: with quant profile Q4_0 memory footprint is ~+8% vs v1 on our staging GPUs — we should confirm staging pool fits.
suresh: Owners summarized: deploy = anya, app smoke + quality = kevin, infra/route = maria, console/alerts = julie, oncall = ops-oncall. I'll shadow the run.
anya: I'll post a 1-hour-before checklist in this thread and ping when ready :thumbsup: 
kevin: small CR ask — @suresh can you rebase the PR? There's a tiny conflict in the model card.
suresh: done, rebased and pushed.
deploy-bot: deploy job 987654 changed state: queued -> running
maria: priming started against a few hot prefixes, ETA ~3m
kevin: smoke run started against canary (10 prompts)
kevin: smoke results: latency p95 115ms, 0 failures, quality diffs within expected tolerances
ops-oncall: no alerts so far; monitoring error budget (98% remaining)
anya: looks good to me. Proceeding to increase to 25% after 30m hold.
suresh: thanks — please capture any anomalies in the deploy ticket. I'll update the model catalog entry if the promotion completes.
deploy-bot: deploy job 987654 succeeded: canary finished and promoted to 25% traffic
suresh: final checks: confirm rollback script location and runbook link in case we need immediate revert.
maria: runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/galileo3b-deploy — rollback script path `scripts/rollback_pin.sh` available in PR artifacts.
anya: I'll close the deploy ticket and mark calendar event done once we hit 25% stability window.
kevin: leaving a few notes in the PR about expected perf deltas and the prompt set we used for smoke.
suresh: great work everyone — if 25% holds for the next 15m we'll promote to full and pin galileo-3b to v2 in the model catalog. Post-mortem + checklist updates will follow.
